messages:
Maya Chen: Quick ask — can we tighten the morning triage to 20min and switch to async updates for low-priority incidents? Proposal: 9:00am PST quick bridge (20m), then async thread for P3/P4. Need at least 1 escalation lead + 1 triage engineer. Who can commit to the rotation? @Jasper @Ravi
Jasper O'Neill: sounds good to me. Is this for weekdays only? Also EU overlap: can someone cover 16:00 UTC on rotation days? :thinking:
Ravi Patel: Weekdays only sounds fine. I can take EU overlap next Tue/Wed. Can we rotate escalation lead every 3 days instead of 1? reduces context switching.
Elena Garcia: I'm happy to be escalation lead tomorrow morning. Also +1 for async updates — we should use the incident doc template and link it in thread.
oncall-bot: Reminder: Open incidents: INC-782 (P2), INC-799 (P3). Bridge: https://meet.redwood/triage-bridge. Active oncall: Maya Chen. :bell:
Maya Chen: thanks @Elena — I'll add doc. Proposed minimal agenda for 9:00 bridge:
```
- Quick rollcall (2m)
- Open P1/P2 quick sync (8m)
- Assign owners + escalation handoff (6m)
- Confirm async threads + followups (4m)
```
Can we agree to this cadence? say :thumbsup: if yes
Jasper O'Neill: :thumbsup: If we're rotating every 3 days, can we have a visible calendar? I'll add an entry to the oncall calendar and share.
Ravi Patel: I'll update the incident doc template with a field for 'escalation lead' and 'async-thread-link'
Elena Garcia: FYI — I added a comment in the doc: add 'estimated impact' field. small change. :+1:
Maya Chen: Awesome. I'll send calendar invites for the first week and ping everyone tomorrow at 08:50 PST. Thanks all.
